title.zh: 将孔波斯特拉谷省 Mabini 市镇 Pindasan 描笼涯的 Mabini 国立中学的 Pindasan 附属校分离，改设为独立的同名国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Mabini National High School - Pindasan Annex in Barangay Pindasan, Municipality of Mabini, Province of Compostela Valley from the Main Mabini National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Pindasan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Mabini National High School - Pindasan Annex in Barangay Pindasan, Municipality of Mabini, Province of Compostela Valley from the Main Mabini National High School, Converting it into an Independent National High School to Be Known as Pindasan National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Pindasan của Trường Trung học Mabini Quốc gia tại Barangay Pindasan, Đô thị Mabini, Tỉnh Compostela Valley khỏi Trường Trung học Main Mabini Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Pindasan Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Pindasan ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Mabini แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Pindasan เทศบาล Mabini จังหวัด Compostela Valley ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Main Mabini แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pindasan แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Pindasan, Sekolah Menengah Mabini Nasional di Barangay Pindasan, Kotamadya Mabini, Provinsi Compostela Valley dari Sekolah Menengah Main Mabini Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pindasan Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Pindasan, Sekolah Menengah Mabini Kebangsaan di Barangay Pindasan, Perbandaran Mabini, Wilayah Compostela Valley daripada Sekolah Menengah Main Mabini Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Pindasan Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. - The Mabini National High School - Pindasan Annex in Barangay Pindasan, Municipality of Mabini, Province of Compostela Valley is hereby separated from the Main Mabini National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Pindasan National High School

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Mabini National High School - Pindasan Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Pindasan National High School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Pindasan National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Mabini National High School - Pindasan Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for. the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
